svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the sheet to 900 x 450 mm; round the corners lightly.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front notches, one at each end: 20 mm in from the end edge and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60 mm long, from 85 to 145 mm back from the front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rear notches: 40 x 20 mm at each back corner.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Frame screws: 5.5 mm, countersunk from the top, over the T-nuts

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in the frame's top slots (mark through from the frame).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guard rods: four 10.5 mm holes on a 156 mm square centred 175

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: right of the middle and 40 in front of the centre line. Press an

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M10 tee nut into each from below before the deck goes on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Water post: one 5.5 mm countersunk hole from below, 146 right of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the left end and 80 back from the front edge; fit the post now.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mounts (stand, feet, brackets, cradle, saddle, regulator, bridge):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: set each in place later, mark through its holes, drill 4 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pilots 10 deep, fix with 5 mm stainless self-tapping screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drip lip: 10 x 10 x 1.5 angle, front 900 and four end pieces;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screw every 100 mm on a bead of silicone.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the deck lies flat on the frame with every notch clear.
